name: Zenith Sorceress's Secret
effects: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Y'shtola II] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Y'shtola II] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Y'shtola II
description.text: Increases [Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Black Magic or Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Y'shtola II after using a Black Magic or Witch ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Y'shtola II
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (3000)] to all allies, and grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user after 3 chases

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
